about_short_description.short_description: Tenant Turner is a Y Combinator-company formed out of the aftermath of the 2008 financial and housing crisis.

product.name: Tenant Turner Leasing Automation Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates residential leasing workflows from listing and lead qualification through showing scheduling, follow-up, applications, and performance reporting.

product.name: AI Virtual Agent
product.description: An AI web and text agent that answers rental questions, presents relevant listings, pre-qualifies prospects, and schedules showings outside normal business hours.

product.name: Live Answer
product.description: A human-operated leasing call service that handles prospect inquiries, showing scheduling, self-access assistance, and troubleshooting around the clock.

product.name: Tenant Turner Access Devices
product.description: Smart locks and digital lockboxes integrated with Tenant Turner to provide controlled, remote access for self-guided property showings.

identifier.value: Tenant Turner Leasing Support and Onboarding

product.name: Tenant Turner Leasing Support and Onboarding
product.description: Implementation and customer support services that help property managers configure integrations, leasing workflows, access devices, and user operations.
